ANSWER: NO
HALLUCINATIONS: None

All key financial terms in the memo are supported by the source document:

- Date of Agreement (November 30, 2020) ✓
- Borrower name (MGE Niagara Entertainment Inc.) ✓
- Administrative Agent (Bank of Montreal) ✓
- Guarantor (Complex Services Inc.) ✓
- Original credit agreement dates (June 10, 2019, amended July 17, 2019) ✓
- Extended Waiver Period (until March 31, 2021) ✓
- Minimum liquidity requirement ($15,000,000) ✓
- Level 5 pricing rates (BA/LIBOR: 5.00%, Prime/USBR: 3.50%) ✓
- Extension fee (5 basis points) ✓
- Undrawn fee (1.25%) ✓
- Weekly liquidity reporting requirement ✓
- No new advances restriction ✓
- OLG payment continuity requirements (5 business days threshold) ✓
- All covenant restrictions mentioned ✓

The memo accurately reflects the financial terms and conditions contained in the Fifth Amended and Restated Limited Waiver document.

ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS: 
- Original credit agreement date (June 10, 2019, amended July 17, 2019)
- Timeline of previous waivers (May 2020, June 2020, July 2020, September 2020)
- Specific financial covenant sections being waived (Sections 9.4.1 and 9.4.2)
- Compliance certificate delivery requirements under Section 9.1.1.3(a)
- Annual Business Plan delivery requirements under Section 9.1.1.4
- Complete pricing grid showing all levels (1-5) with corresponding leverage ratios and rates
- Specific restrictions on contract amendments (Leases, MGE Management Agreement, CNHI Consulting Agreement, Convertible Debentures)
- Weekly liquidity reporting schedule (Tuesday of each week commencing August 4, 2020)
- Governing law (Province of Ontario and federal laws of Canada)
